{{- /* figure: an image with an optional caption. `alt` is required (STYLE_GUIDE.md "Images"): without it the caption stands in as the alt text, or alt="" as a last resort, and the build warns (warning id figure-no-alt; silence it with ignoreLogs if an old version floods the log). The alt is attribute-escaped by the template, so quotes, & and < in it are safe in the HTML. A double quote inside a "…" shortcode argument still ends the argument: write such alt text in backticks (alt=`The "Sales" bar chart`). */ -}} {{- $src := .Get "src" -}} {{- if and $src (not (urls.Parse $src).Scheme) -}} {{- $src = strings.TrimPrefix "/" $src | relURL -}} {{- end -}} {{- $alt := .Get "alt" -}} {{- if not $alt -}} {{- warnidf "figure-no-alt" "figure %q has no alt text: add alt=\"…\" (%s)" (.Get "src") .Position -}} {{- with .Get "caption" }}{{ $alt = . | markdownify | plainify }}{{ end -}} {{- end -}} {{- with .Get "caption" -}} {{- end -}}
